name: The Stolen Journal
summary: Grelin Whitebeard needs his stolen journal to finish judging the troll threat in Coldridge Valley. Grik'nir the Cold, leader of the Frostmane, carried it into the troll cave, leaving Grelin without most of his reconnaissance.

sections.title: A Scholar's Lost Notes
sections.body: The Frostmane trolls have pressed into Coldridge Valley, and Grelin Whitebeard's notes track them. They record the trolls' habits and their sudden aggression. During the unrest, an imposing troll stole Grelin's personal journal and fled into the depths of the den. The journal holds most of his reconnaissance, so Grelin cannot finish his assessment until it is recovered.

sections.title: Confronting Grik'nir the Cold
sections.body: Grik'nir the Cold holds court in the heart of the valley's troll cave. Distinctive paint marks his body and face. Defeating this powerful Frostmane troll breaks the cave trolls' immediate leadership and secures Grelin's journal. With it returned, Grelin can finish his findings, judge the local troll situation manageable, and send his report to his brother Senir.

faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold took Grelin Whitebeard's journal. The large Frostmane troll has strange markings on his skin and face, and lurks deep in the troll cave.

faq.q: Where can Grik'nir the Cold be found?
faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold is inside the troll cave in the southern reaches of Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Why is the journal important to Grelin?
aliases: why does grelin want his journal
faq.answer: Grelin's journal holds his notes and findings on troll activity in Coldridge Valley. He needs it back to complete a report for his brother Senir.

faq.q: What happens after you return the journal?
aliases: what is next after the stolen journal
faq.answer: After you recover the journal, Grelin finishes his report on the troll situation in Coldridge Valley. He asks you to carry his findings to his brother Senir Whitebeard at Kharanos.

faq.q: Are the Frostmane trolls driven out of Coldridge Valley after this?
faq.answer: Grelin believes the troll situation in Coldridge Valley is under control after Grik'nir's defeat. The Frostmane remain a threat across Dun Morogh's broader mountain passes.
Senir Whitebeard is Grelin's brother, an Alliance scout stationed outside Coldridge Valley near Kharanos. He gathers intelligence on threats facing the kingdom.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you help protect young recruits taking their first steps beyond Anvilmar. You break Frostmane leadership in Coldridge Valley.
As a gnome, you rely on the safety of Coldridge Valley's passes. Gnomish refugees shelter in Anvilmar and regroup in dwarven territory.
As an Alliance member, you help keep Dun Morogh's starting valleys secure from disruption. You do so by suppressing the aggressive Frostmane tribe.
